narrative.overview:
The page is Ana's fair stand, rebuilt as a screen. The whole surface is a bordó pegboard punched with deep-bordó holes on a strict 28px pitch, and everything on it is a physical object: a printed sign hung from two hooks, a wire strung with price tags naming the categories, and the channels as printed card stock hung from steel J-hooks. Nothing floats; every piece hangs from a hole, tilts slightly at rest, and casts a real hanging shadow onto the board.

The palette is a bordó drench with one sticker-yellow piece. Cards are off-white stock printed in bordó ink; the online store is the single yellow card, the widest piece, hung from two hooks. Type is a single variable family, Archivo, pushed across its width axis: expanded and black for the stand's sign and the store card, near-normal for captions.

Motion is physical and damped. Cards drop onto their hooks with a pendulum settle, swing from the hook when touched or hovered, sway slightly with scroll, and the two-hook store card hops instead of swinging. With reduced motion everything is static and the wire becomes scrollable.
keyCharacteristics: Bordó pegboard drench with a 28px hole grid; hooks snap to real holes.
Printed paper cards in bordó ink; one yellow card for the primary destination.
Three die-cut silhouettes: euro-slot sign, euro-slot blister, cut-corner tie tag.
Two-layer drop shadow on every hung piece; no flat floating panels.
Single variable family (Archivo) with width as the hierarchy lever.
Pendulum motion anchored at the hook, fully disabled under reduced motion.

rules.name: The One Sticker Rule
rules.body: Sticker Yellow fills exactly one card on the board: the primary destination. Its other uses are interaction states only (focus ring, selection), never decoration or a second card.

rules.name: The Printed-In-Bordó Rule
rules.body: Paper pieces are printed in the bordó family only (bordo for titles and strokes, ink for running text). No new hues enter the board; the only non-bordó colors are yellow, paper, and steel.

rules.name: The Width-Is-Rank Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy steps through the width axis (125 / 118 / 112 / 110 / 108 / 100) together with weight. Don't add a second typeface to create contrast.

rules.name: The Everything-Hangs Rule
rules.body: A piece on the board hangs from a hook in a hole and casts the hanging drop. No piece floats flat on the board without hardware.

dos: Do hang every new piece from a hook whose center snaps to the 28px hole grid, with a matching slot cut into the piece.
Do give every hung piece the two-layer hanging drop and a small resting tilt.
Do print new cards on paper in bordó and ink, with an icon in a stroked bordó tile.
Do rank type through Archivo's width axis and weight before reaching for size.
Do anchor all motion at the hook (transform origin above the piece) and turn it all off under reduced motion.
donts: Don't stack the channels as a vertical column of identical pill buttons.
Don't fill a second card with Sticker Yellow; it marks only the primary destination.
Don't introduce hues outside the bordó family, paper, yellow, and steel.
Don't lay a piece flat on the board without a hook, slot, and hanging shadow.
